program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (first-row-vals (filter (lambda (v) (!= v 0))
                                        (map (lambda (c) (at g 1 c)) (range 1 18))))
                (freq (map (lambda (v)
                             (cons v
                                   (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x v)) first-row-vals))))
                           (unique first-row-vals)))
                (bg (fst (first (sort-by freq (lambda (p) (* -1 (snd p))))))))
           (let* ((marks-in-cell (lambda (br bc)
                                   (let ((r0 (+ 1 (* br 6)))
                                         (c0 (+ 1 (* bc 6))))
                                     (filter (lambda (p)
                                               (!= bg
                                                   (at g (+ r0 (fst p)) (+ c0 (snd p)))))
                                             (reduce append
                                                     (list)
                                                     (map (lambda (r)
                                                            (map (lambda (c) (cons r c))
                                                                 (range 0 5)))
                                                          (range 0 5)))))))
                  (target-pos (lambda (br bc)
                                (let* ((marks (marks-in-cell br bc))
                                       (n (length marks))
                                       (sr (reduce + 0 (map fst marks)))
                                       (sc (reduce + 0 (map snd marks)))
                                       (cr (/ sr (+ 0.0 n)))
                                       (cc (/ sc (+ 0.0 n)))
                                       (tR (if (< cr 1.5) 0 (if (<= cr 2.5) 1 2)))
                                       (tC (if (< cc 1.5) 0 (if (<= cc 2.5) 1 2))))
                                  (cons tR tC))))
                  (find-source (lambda (tbr tbc)
                                 (first (filter (lambda (sp)
                                                  (let ((tgt (target-pos (fst sp)
                                                                         (snd sp))))
                                                    (and
                                                      (= (fst tgt) tbr)
                                                      (= (snd tgt) tbc))))
                                                (reduce append
                                                        (list)
                                                        (map (lambda (br)
                                                               (map (lambda (bc)
                                                                      (cons br bc))
                                                                    (range 0 3)))
                                                             (range 0 3))))))))
             (grid-from-fn h
                           w
                           (lambda (r c)
                             (if (or
                                   (zero? r)
                                   (= r 6)
                                   (= r 12)
                                   (= r 18)
                                   (zero? c)
                                   (= c 6)
                                   (= c 12)
                                   (= c 18))
                                 0
                                 (let* ((tbr (if (< r 6) 0 (if (< r 12) 1 2)))
                                        (tbc (if (< c 6) 0 (if (< c 12) 1 2)))
                                        (r0 (+ 1 (* tbr 6)))
                                        (c0 (+ 1 (* tbc 6)))
                                        (lr (- r r0))
                                        (lc (- c c0))
                                        (src (find-source tbr tbc))
                                        (sbr (fst src))
                                        (sbc (snd src))
                                        (sr0 (+ 1 (* sbr 6)))
                                        (sc0 (+ 1 (* sbc 6))))
                                   (at g (+ sr0 lr) (+ sc0 lc))))))))))
